subject.title: Include participant identity and quoted reply context in gateway inbound log

question: Should persistent WhatsApp inbound gateway logs store raw participant identifiers and quoted reply content, or should that metadata be redacted, hashed, gated, or omitted?
rationale: The implementation location is clear, but choosing the log retention/privacy boundary for raw WhatsApp identifiers and quoted message bodies is a maintainer security/product decision that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Redacted or opt-in metadata
options.body: Add sender/thread correlation in a way that preserves safe defaults, such as redacted identifiers, hashed IDs, quoted-body gating, or an explicit operator-controlled log mode.

options.title: Approve raw fields
options.body: Treat raw participant IDs, phone numbers, names, quoted IDs, and quoted bodies as intentional persistent log data and require tests plus redacted live proof before landing.

options.title: Keep logs minimal
options.body: Leave persistent inbound logs as basic operational traces and direct richer offline processing to a separate audited export or plugin-hook contract.

recommendation.title: Redacted or opt-in metadata
recommendation.body: Add sender/thread correlation in a way that preserves safe defaults, such as redacted identifiers, hashed IDs, quoted-body gating, or an explicit operator-controlled log mode.
